definition: A secondary identity constructed entirely within the Diaspora — distinct from legal name, BCI registration, or corponation ID — used by synthetics, E.L.F.s, and humans seeking privacy. Carries full social weight in certain communities even though it holds no official standing.
origin: Synth rights movement terminology, later adopted by privacy advocates and off-grid humans
usage: Synthetic persons, E.L.F. proxies, underground Diaspora communities, privacy-conscious Tier 1–2 residents
example: She introduced herself by her lattice name — Sable Voss — and everyone at the table understood that no other name would be used or sought.
